document_api_meta.title: List Opportunities
document_api_meta.env_desc: Search and retrieve a paginated list of opportunity leads available to the authorized seller, with optional filters by type, status, category, etc and ordered by the algorithm ranking model.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc: Number of results per page. Max: 100. Default: 20.

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: Pagination token from previous response. Omit for first page.

request_query_param.name: locale
request_query_param.desc: The locale for localized category names, tags, and reward information, expressed as a BCP-47 language-country code, for example `en-US`. If omitted, the primary locale for the seller's shop region is used.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: opportunity_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of opportunity.
Possible values:
- `PRODUCT`: Product opportunity
- `KEYWORD`: Search keyword opportunity
- `CATEGORY`: Category opportunity

request_body_param.name: category_ids
request_body_param.desc: Filter by category IDs. Leave empty to return all leads that available to the seller.

request_body_param.name: create_time_ge
request_body_param.desc: Filter opportunities created at or after this time. Provide a Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC).

request_body_param.name: create_time_lt
request_body_param.desc: Filter opportunities created before this time. timestamp in seconds

request_body_param.name: tag_codes
request_body_param.desc: A list of tag codes used to filter the results. You can provide at most 20 values. Use lowercase tag codes. The `core_product` and `top_product` tag codes are supported only when `opportunity_type` is `PRODUCT`; their availability also depends on the seller and market configuration.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^data
response_param.desc: Paginated opportunity results.

response_param.name: ^^opportunities
response_param.desc: The opportunities returned on the current page.

response_param.name: ^^^id
response_param.desc: Unique ID of the opportunity

response_param.name: ^^^title
response_param.desc: Opportunity title.

response_param.name: ^^^reference_images
response_param.desc: Reference product images of the product to list.

response_param.name: ^^^category_id_level_1
response_param.desc: TikTok Shop L1 category ID.

response_param.name: ^^^category_id_level_2
response_param.desc: TikTok Shop L2 category ID.

response_param.name: ^^^category_id_level_3
response_param.desc: TikTok Shop L3 category ID.

response_param.name: ^^^category_name_level_1
response_param.desc: Category name of 1st level category.

response_param.name: ^^^category_name_level_2
response_param.desc: Category name of 2nd level category.

response_param.name: ^^^category_name_level_3
response_param.desc: Category name of 3rd level category.

response_param.name: ^^^is_collected
response_param.desc: Whether the authorized seller has saved this opportunity to their collection.

response_param.name: ^^^query_words
response_param.desc: Comma-separated TikTok Shop in-site search keywords associated with the opportunity.

response_param.name: ^^^opportunity_type
response_param.desc:
Type of opportunity: PRODUCT（品线索）/ KEYWORD（词线索）/ CATEGORY（类目线索）
Empty return for a specific opportunity type indicates the business team has not enabled merchant submission for this lead type in the corresponding market.

response_param.name: ^^^brand_name
response_param.desc: The brand name for products specified by the opportunity.

response_param.name: ^^^create_time
response_param.desc: The opportunity creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC).

response_param.name: ^^^expire_time
response_param.desc: Opportunity expiry date, second-level timestamp

response_param.name: ^^^est_market_sales_volume
response_param.desc: Estimated market sales volume for the last 30 days, returned as an approximate bucket: `<100`, a value rounded down to a hundreds bucket ending in `00+`, a `k+` or `M+` value, or `100M+`.

response_param.name: ^^^est_market_gmv
response_param.desc: Estimated market sales GMV in USD for the last 30 days, returned as an approximate bucket: `<100`, a value rounded down to a hundreds bucket ending in `00+`, a `k+` or `M+` value, or `100M+`.

response_param.name: ^^^search_volume
response_param.desc: TikTok Shop in-site search volume, rounded to the nearest whole number and returned as a decimal string.

response_param.name: ^^^competitor_product_count
response_param.desc: Approximate number of competing products listed in the last 30 days, returned as one of `< 10`, `< 50`, `< 100`, or `100+`.

response_param.name: ^^^video_view_pv
response_param.desc: The cumulative short video view count of all videos associated with this product opportunity.

response_param.name: ^^^tags
response_param.example: Pencarian teratas,Pencarian trending,Persaingan rendah,Trending di TikTok,Terlaris
response_param.desc: Comma-separated display values for the opportunity tags. Each value is localized when a translation is available; otherwise, the configured tag description or tag code is returned.

response_param.name: ^^^tag_codes
response_param.desc: Tag codes for the opportunity. The available codes depend on seller and market configuration. Examples for Latam include `core_product` and `top_product`.

response_param.name: ^^^reward_info
response_param.desc: Comma-separated descriptions of rewards that sellers can gain by listing products as required. Values are localized when a translation is available; otherwise, the configured reward description is returned.

response_param.name: ^^^external_product_id
response_param.desc: Product ID on the reference source.

response_param.name: ^^^reference_source
response_param.desc:
The reference platform code, returned only when `external_product_id` is present.
Possible values:
- `1`: SHOPEE
- `2`: AMAZON
- `3`: LOOKFANTASTIC
- `4`: WALMART
- `5`: TTS
- `6`: ASOS
- `7`: UNIVERSAL_PRODUCT
- `8`: DTCNEXUS
- `9`: TEMU
- `10`: SHOPIFY
- `11`: NEXUS_SHOPIFY
- `12`: SHEIN
- `13`: PIXEL
- `14`: SHOPIFY_NON_1P
- `15`: MIRAVIA
- `16`: RAKUTEN
- `17`: EBAY
- `18`: ONBUY
- `19`: MERCADO_LIBRE
- `20`: ALLEGRO
- `21`: BOL
- `22`: DTC

response_param.name: ^^next_page_token
response_param.desc: Pagination token to pass as `page_token` in the next request. This field is omitted when there are no more results.

response_param.name: ^^total_count
response_param.desc: Total number of matching opportunities (approximate).
